jobs.name: a-quiet-arcade
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a new full desktop screen mockup for Power Agents. The supplied image is reference for the 32-bit pixel-art vocabulary and Ranger identity ONLY; its packed layout is rejected. RADICALLY SIMPLIFY and give the entire platform generous empty space. Pixel styling belongs to the entire UI, not just a scene pasted into a generic modern dashboard. Minimalist premium indie-game menu / calm console RPG interface. Crisp visible pixels, restrained bitmap type, slender stepped-corner outlines, tiny pixel icons, small tasteful two-tone bevel only on the primary button. At least 35% flat unoccupied negative space; 64px outer margins, generous gutters. No giant logo, slogans, textured UI wallpaper, decorative skyline in header/footer, repeated portraits, chrome window buttons, layered borders, multiple chat panels, fake meters, money, HP or XP. No physical monitor. Landscape 1536x1024.
Small top-left wordmark 'POWER AGENTS', quiet navigation 'Workspace' 'Runs' 'Connections', small '+ New task' top right. Below with generous separation: modest title 'Product research', subdued 'Plan approved · 1 of 4 tasks complete', small 'Pause' button. One medium-wide city encounter viewport is main focus, with thin simple pixel border, no labels covering the scene. Beautiful simplified low-detail modern city, clear side-on slightly three-quarter street, comfortable open sky and muted buildings. Only FOUR full-body figures with room around them: orange/cream Claude with straight rigid copper bo staff, periwinkle-blue/white Codex with narrow straight silver saber, blue/white Gemini Ranger with red yellow green accents and small blaster, in triangle on left; one red/gold tokusatsu monster on right. Gemini is a BLUE HERO not an insect. Preserve distinct costumes. All weapons and feet complete in frame. Pixel density consistent, deliberate stepped shading not smooth illustration.
Under the scene just one slim row 'Claude · Waiting     Codex · Working     Gemini · Reviewing'. One understated task area with tabs 'Tasks' 'Messages' 'Results', only 3 spacious rows: 'Audience research / Complete', 'Compare solutions / Working', 'Review findings / Waiting'. Messages and results stay behind tabs, do NOT display their contents simultaneously. Small discreet input 'Message the team...' and 'Send'. Functional hierarchy without extra invented UI. Tiny footer 'Design study · sample data'. Keep all text readable; calm space is intentional. Direction: QUIET ARCADE. Matte deep desaturated midnight navy background, off-white bitmap lettering, muted slate outlines, one warm golden-yellow primary accent. Scene and sparse task panel sit SIDE BY SIDE, main scene left approximately 65% of content, slim task panel right35%, both generously padded. No sidebar. Rich Ranger colors are the strongest visual accent besides tiny yellow button. Large calm empty margins above and below. Understated game interface, not dashboard, no visual clutter.
